row.title: SLA-8H-1: nothing open past 8 hours
row.body: Root causes: dispose ttl_days 14 let queue items (mirrored as GitHub issues) sit for days; the sweeper superseded only agent/* dirty PRs, never claude/* or ci-failed PRs; ghmirror kept 'done:' items open. Fix: dispose ttl_hours 6 on the 10-minute fleet pass, sweeper ladder closes any client PR past 6 h (branch kept), agewatch --check on every fleet pass.
